tokens.name: ground-top
tokens.usage: First stop of the ground gradient (top-left). Warm cream in Pearl, near-black in Glass. Also the cut-out colour for patterns.

tokens.name: ground-mid
tokens.usage: Second stop of the ground gradient; base fill for raised controls such as Button.

tokens.name: ground-lilac
tokens.usage: Third stop of the ground gradient — the cool lilac-grey middle of the surface.

tokens.name: ground-sage
tokens.usage: Last stop of the ground gradient (bottom-right). The sage tint the accent is taken from.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Fill of a Well (inputs, selected states), always paired with the well-inset shadow. Cards have no fill.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of a GlassCard: a frosted pane that sits on the ground.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px border of a GlassCard and of icon tiles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on every ground stop (≥ 5.9:1 on ground-sage in Pearl).

tokens.name: ink-display
tokens.usage: Light-weight display type (32px and up), always with deboss-text. Softer than ink so the emboss carries the edge; passes 3:1 for large text.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Marks that must read crisply: chart axes, the prior-work ✕, icon strokes.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Kickers, captions, legends, axis labels. 4.5:1 on ground-lilac in Pearl — do not lighten.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections and inside legends.

tokens.name: engrave
tokens.usage: The dark cut of an engraved line or frame (always 1px, always with a highlight catch 1px below). Never use a light ink for an engraved line: on Glass that draws a line instead of cutting one.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The light edge of the emboss: duplicate a stroke 1px lower in this colour to press it into the surface.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: The dark edge of the emboss, 1px above a glyph or stroke.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: deep sage-teal in Pearl, cyan glow in Glass. Highlighted results, key figures, primary buttons, focus rings. Use sparingly — one idea per view.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Halo around an accent data point and fill of a lit GlassCard.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a filled accent Button (5.6:1 in Pearl).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Alternate accent (ink blue) for a second series or a re-themed piece. Never alongside accent as two competing highlights.

tokens.name: accent-violet
tokens.usage: Alternate accent (muted violet), same rules as accent-ink.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Warm amber for 'trending' and attention icons only — 3.2:1 in Pearl, so never for body text.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One headline per board, ink-display + deboss-text.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headline, or the headline on a Glass board.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Stat figures, in accent with deboss-text.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Breadcrumb above a headline. Sentence case, no tracking, no monospace.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Circuits land down and to the left of the best published designs.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph under a headline, max 700px wide.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Positions are read from the published chart.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chart tick labels, ink-muted, tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a figure and its caption.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between legend rows and card title to chart.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutter between Wells; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between header and content on a board.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Board bottom padding; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Board side margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bars in a bar chart.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small icon tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Wells, legends, press items.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: GlassCards and large panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags.

shadow.note: Depth in Pearl is pressed in, not lifted out: a highlight below, a shade above. Raised is reserved for things you can press.

tokens.name: deboss-text
tokens.usage: Use as text-shadow on display type, kickers and card titles — the signature effect.

tokens.name: well-inset
tokens.usage: A soft recess for inputs, selected tabs and the pressed state of a Button. Not for cards: they use engrave-hairline.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Buttons at rest only.

tokens.name: engrave-hairline
tokens.usage: The default card edge (pearl-card), and a very thin, sharp engraved border — a 1px cut with a light catch under its bottom edge and inside its top edge, like the line etched into the Willow plate. Use with no border and no fill on plaques, frames and outlined labels (pearl-engrave). No blur: it must stay crisp.

tokens.name: engrave-rule
tokens.usage: The light catch under an engraved line. Put it on a 1px-tall element filled with shade (pearl-rule) for a divider etched into the surface; lines may run at any angle and meet in a T.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The one highlighted GlassCard on a board (the 'new' thing).
